_siteUrlNote: The canonical origin. Canonical links, hreflang, og:url and sitemap.xml are all built from it. symptoms-app.com was chosen on 2026-09-14: it is the domain GEOTEC's project page links to, it carries its own Google-issued certificate for the apex and www, and www already redirects to it. symptoms-web.web.app serves the identical site and is consolidated by the canonical tags.
_socialLinksNote: style is the Font Awesome family: 'brands' for a company mark, 'solid' for a generic glyph. label is the accessible name -- main.css hides it visually (.icon > .label { display: none }), so it is all a screen reader gets. Facebook and Instagram were removed on 2026-09-10: both were href='#'.
_stylesheetsNote: Order matters: fonts.css and fontawesome-all.min.css used to be @imported at the top of main.css (removed 2026-09-14), so they come first to keep the same cascade.

_shareNote: Link-preview image for every page. 1200x630 is the ratio Facebook, LinkedIn and X expect; the old image was the 1000x221 wordmark, which previews cropped to the middle letters. Generated by tools/make-icons.mjs.
_sitemapExtraNote: Files in src/standalone/ that belong in sitemap.xml. Templated pages are added automatically.
_pagesNote: title: the browser tab and search-result title. description: search snippet and link preview, required for every indexable page -- keep it to ~160 characters and to claims the page itself makes. locales: restrict a page to some locales (default: all). noindex: keep a page out of search and the sitemap. rootRelative: root-absolute asset paths and links, for a page served at arbitrary depths.

description.en: A GEOTEC and LABPSITEC research project at Universitat Jaume I developing smartphone- and sensor-based solutions for mental health diagnosis and treatment.
description.es: Proyecto de investigación de GEOTEC y LABPSITEC en la Universitat Jaume I que desarrolla soluciones basadas en smartphones y sensores para la salud mental.

description.en: SyMptOMS research lines: mobile devices, wearables and mobile games, with smartphone sensors that detect patients’ movement to or from predefined places.
description.es: Líneas de investigación de SyMptOMS: móviles, dispositivos portátiles y videojuegos, con sensores que detectan desplazamientos a lugares predefinidos.

description.en: A randomized controlled trial for anxiety disorder and published case studies on panic disorder with agoraphobia and gambling problems, all built on SyMptOMS.
description.es: Un ensayo controlado aleatorizado sobre trastorno de ansiedad y casos publicados de trastorno de pánico con agorafobia y juego patológico, con SyMptOMS.

description.en: The SyMptOMS platform: an Android app for patients, a web app for configuring each patient's treatment, and a web app for tracking their progress.
description.es: La plataforma SyMptOMS: una app Android para pacientes, una aplicación web para configurar cada tratamiento y otra para seguir la evolución del paciente.

description.en: Journal articles, conference papers and theses published by the SyMptOMS research project.
description.es: Artículos en revistas, contribuciones a congresos y tesis del proyecto de investigación SyMptOMS.

description.en: News and updates on the SyMptOMS project from the GEOTEC research group at Universitat Jaume I.
description.es: Noticias y novedades del proyecto SyMptOMS, del grupo de investigación GEOTEC de la Universitat Jaume I.

description.en: The interdisciplinary team behind SyMptOMS: developers and clinical psychologists from GEOTEC and LABPSITEC at Universitat Jaume I.
description.es: El equipo interdisciplinario detrás de SyMptOMS: desarrolladores y especialistas en psicología clínica de GEOTEC y LABPSITEC, en la Universitat Jaume I.

description.en: How the SyMptOMS mobile application, developed by GEOTEC, collects, uses and protects user information.
description.es: Cómo la aplicación móvil SyMptOMS, desarrollada por GEOTEC, recopila, usa y protege la información de los usuarios.

description.en: A randomized controlled trial of SyMptOMS-JIT, a sensor-based, smartphone-guided in vivo exposure therapy using just-in-time interventions for anxiety disorder.
description.es: Ensayo controlado aleatorizado de SyMptOMS-JIT, una terapia de exposición in vivo guiada por smartphone y basada en sensores, con intervenciones just-in-time.
